_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-06-28 · Session 82 (SkyFlyer) · the public Fact Sheet is now editable everywhere it has boxes/images, meets WCAG 2.1 AA, and exports a Word doc as well as a PDF
_status: Just shipped (live on the next Pages deploy, PR #584): the public CPL Fact Sheet is now fully Curate-able — the Veteran-Sprint boxes are editable/moveable with an Add box, the KPI cards can be reordered and hidden (but not text-edited, since they're live data), the budget table can be hidden, and every grid section has its own ＋Add box. Plus ~15 new embedded links, an accessibility pass (it now meets the WCAG 2.1 AA it advertises), print fixes (the navy funding-table header was printing white-on-white — fixed), and a new ⬇ Word button next to Print/PDF. A few number-consistency items on the Fact Sheet were SURFACED, not silently changed (they're live/snapshot data) — see the item below. The standing engineering lanes (M-ID renumber, TMC acceptance engine, CPL-Assistant recommender ETL) are unchanged and next up.

items.text: On the public CPL Fact Sheet, sign in and ✎ Curate: now you can edit/move/add/delete boxes in the Vet Sprint & CPL Bump sections too, reorder & hide the KPI cards, hide the budget table, and every grid has its own ＋Add box. Try the new ⬇ Word button (next to Print) — it exports a Word doc with your edits + live numbers.

3 small number-consistency items on the Fact Sheet I flagged but did NOT change (they're live/snapshot data or your call): Statewide says '12 program areas' but 13 rows are listed (incl. an 'Other Statewide' catch-all); the could-adopt total 116 (deduped) sits oddly next to per-area rows summing to 454; and '30,000' (Phase-1 JST goal) vs '34,000+' (vets in system). Say the word and I'll reconcile any.

One-time: add the Fact Sheet URL (or …/cpl-project-tracker/**) to the Supabase Auth → Redirect URLs list so a direct magic-link sign-in from the Fact Sheet lands back on that page (today it completes on the dashboard tab).

Magic links opening in Edge instead of Chrome: in classic Outlook, File → Options → Advanced → Link handling → set 'Open hyperlinks from Outlook in' to Default Browser; and make Chrome the Windows default (Settings → Apps → Default apps → Chrome → Set default).
Skim the Annual Report draft — it auto-assembles from live data AND folds in the latest posted status updates; tweak any section in place, then ✨AI-polish / ⬇Word / 🖨Print.
Review and merge public Knowledge Base PR #15 (Veterans plans) when you have a moment — it's been waiting on your sign-off.
Continue the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint per the scope doc — staging-cleanup pass, dry-run first, alias map committed.
Build the TMC Phase-2 acceptance engine (the CO-review scoring that decides whether a college's submitted courses meet each ADT's requirements).
Stand up the CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender ETL so the assistant can suggest the right course/credential a college could adopt.
